execution_scope: Full approved Phase 5B spec: public-good browser direct fetch, real-only cache, no fake fallback display, public homepage Animal Island visual pass, portfolio visual cohesion, admin light consistency, validation constraints, and vision review.

claims.promise: The Phase 5B execution scope includes removing the public-good module's frontend dependency on the Worker proxy, browser direct API access, real API or real historical cache only, public homepage/public-good/portfolio Animal Island styling, admin light visual consistency, and reusing the user's existing localhost:3000 service.

Phase 5B must not add a public-good CMS, exposure analytics, fake/API-document sample normal display, a multi-user admin rewrite, live iframe removal, D1 model redesign, Worker auth redesign, or site CRUD architecture redesign.

Codex must not proactively start npm run dev, npm run dev:all, or another long-lived dev server; browser validation should use the user's already-running http://localhost:3000 and report if it is unavailable.

Phase 5B records user authorization for an external independent Codex review to read/transmit the Phase 5B spec, CSV, claim ledger, review/handoff, code diff, test evidence, and related source unless a tool still requires turn-level confirmation.
The public-good frontend primary path must directly request GET https://api.isoyu.com/gy/api.php from the browser.
Worker /public-good must not be the public page primary data path, local success standard, or fake fallback source for frontend public-good failure handling.

Browser public-good fetching should collect up to five valid records with at most eight attempts, id dedupe, about 6500ms request timeout, about 180ms between attempts, and early stop after two consecutive failures; page refresh must not force a new group every time.

Only validated public-good data may be displayed or cached: id and name required, child_pic required by default, detail URL must be https when present, text fields are trimmed/limited, and raw third-party JSON is not passed directly to components.

The frontend must store only real validated API data in localStorage with a versioned key, 6-hour default TTL, saved/expires metadata, and refresh behavior that preserves historical real cache on failure.

Public-good display rules must show fresh real cache, may show expired historical real cache while refreshing, replace on successful refresh, keep historical real cache on refresh failure, and hide the module if refresh fails with no historical real cache.

API document sample data, Worker documentedPublicGoodSampleItems, Worker fallbackPublicGoodItems, app getPublicGoodFallbackBatch, and generic placeholder public-good records must not enter normal public-good UI.
The homepage brand name must be unified as 小茄的网站小岛 and the first viewport must clearly communicate that brand rather than a generic monitoring/demo page.

The public page must absorb page-level Animal Island elements including Cursor, Nunito + Noto Sans SC, natural/leaf background, warm paper content areas, brown text, Title/ribbon style, Card pattern/Tag/Button controls, Footer/natural decoration, and two to three intentional motions.

The current black grid portfolio-surface background must be replaced by an Animal Island-like natural background using home_bg.webp or equivalent, green #7DC395 support, warm paper content colors, and warm brown text instead of hard #1f2523 as the dominant visual.

The public-good module must sit after the first viewport and before the portfolio list, read as a public notice board rather than an ad slot, and must not emphasize donating a portfolio exposure slot.

The public-good module must show five avatar entries plus one detail notice board, support click switching on mobile, style the selected avatar, show photo/name/status/times/place/features/detail link, and avoid fabricating person data on image failure.
When there is no real public-good data and no historical real cache, the public-good module must not render and must not leave a large blank area or fake no-data notice board.
The portfolio list must keep live iframe as its core preview while visually becoming warm paper/rounded island-like work windows with clear access actions and lower-priority status tags.
The admin must preserve single-admin login, logged-out login-only behavior, logged-in site list/edit/create/update/delete/logout, Worker CRUD, and D1 data path.

The admin should become a light Animal Island-style island office using fonts, warm paper background, rounded panels, brown text, Input/Button/Tag/Card-like controls, optional Modal/delete confirmation, no complex decoration, and no mobile overflow/overlap.
